## The dealer operational problem

What specific dealer operational problem would this skill solve? Be concrete. Examples:

- "Most dealers do not know which AI engines are hallucinating about them."
- "Dealer service drives lose customers because there is no systematic follow-up after a declined repair."
- "Multi-rooftop dealer groups have inconsistent GBP NAP across stores."

## Why it matters

What is the business cost of leaving this problem unsolved? Estimated impact on sales, service revenue, retention, attribution accuracy, market share, or compliance exposure.

## Proposed skill outline

A rough outline of what the skill would do:

- Skill name (working title)
- Audience (dealer principal, marketing director, BDC manager, fixed ops, agency, etc.)
- Audit dimensions or workflow steps
- Output structure (diagnostic report, content brief, campaign plan, etc.)
- Related skills it pairs with (from the existing 23)

## Your background

What is your background relevant to this skill? (Dealer principal at X store, agency operator with N years experience, OEM marketing director, developer with auto retail experience, etc.) This helps us evaluate the contribution and credit you appropriately.

## Are you willing to contribute the build?

- [ ] Yes, I can write SKILL.md, REFERENCE.md, and supporting files following the existing skill structure
- [ ] I can contribute domain knowledge and review drafts but cannot write the skill files myself
- [ ] I am suggesting the idea for the maintainers to build

## Anything else?

Open field for context, references, or related material.
